title: Townsend Brown's time travel tech taken by a group in Nassau

tellings.quote: Shatskin, Brown was constantly saying that his time travel technology was taken by a group in Nassau in the Bahamas.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that an inventor named Townsend Brown kept saying his time travel technology had been taken by a group in Nassau, in the Bahamas. Michels draws this from Paul Schatzkin, author of a book about Brown called The Man Who Mastered Gravity, and from Brown's daughter. If true, it would mean someone quietly took over technology that Brown believed could move through time.
